metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Portrait Album Cover
useCases: Retro soul or jazz compilation covers

retrievalProfile.description: A classic mid-century portrait layout featuring a subject in formal attire against a vibrant, flat color field with bold, condensed header typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A waist-up portrait of a man in a dark suit and white shirt, positioned slightly off-center against a solid, saturated red background, framed by a prominent top-aligned header and a right-aligned tracklist in white condensed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject contrast against a vibrant flat color field
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balanced by right-aligned body text
Formal portraiture lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, slightly left of center, scaled to waist-up height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold white header text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header, moves down to the subject's face, then right to the tracklist text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and around the subject's head, filled by the flat background color.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for all typography and shirt highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black/charcoal for the suit and hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and scales for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif feel of the header.
Provides the clean, mid-century Swiss look for the body text.
Captures the vintage American editorial vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a waist-up portrait of a man in a black 1950s-style suit, white shirt, and black tie, looking towards the camera with a slight smile. The background must be a solid, vibrant, flat red color with no texture or gradients.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, white, extra-condensed sans-serif header across the top. Add a list of song titles in smaller, white, condensed sans-serif text, right-aligned in the middle-right section of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid red?
Is the header text uppercase and extra-condensed?
Is the subject wearing a formal suit and tie?

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the red background
Ensure the subject's head does not overlap the header text
Verify the suit color is a deep, solid black
Confirm the overall layout feels like a 1950s/60s vinyl record
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background color + formal portrait + condensed sans-serif header + right-aligned list = Mid-century album aesthetic.
